plugins.name: Ring Mod
plugins.desc: Multiplies the sound by a tone for robotic, metallic, bell-like textures.

plugins.name: Auto Wah
plugins.desc: A filter that opens up when the sound gets louder — funky wah on guitars, keys and bass.

plugins.name: Tape Wobble
plugins.desc: Slow pitch drift and flutter like an old cassette or warped record.

plugins.name: Exciter
plugins.desc: Adds sparkle and air by generating new high harmonics.

plugins.name: Trance Gate
plugins.desc: Chops pads and chords into rhythmic pulses with a step pattern.

plugins.name: Glass Harp
plugins.desc: Airy, shimmering glass tones that bloom and fade slowly.

plugins.name: FM Marimba
plugins.desc: A woody, hollow mallet sound made with frequency modulation.

plugins.name: Rubber Pluck
plugins.desc: A bouncy, string-like pluck (Karplus-Strong) with a rubbery low end.

plugins.name: Retrowave Pack
plugins.desc: Eight 80s-style Sky Synth sounds: neon leads, gated pads, analog bass.

plugins.name: Chill Keys Pack
plugins.desc: Six soft, mellow Sky Synth sounds for lo-fi and chill songs.
